entities.summary: Dušan's Code, a significant document in the history of Serbia (1331–1371). Part of Serbian Principalities & Nemanjić Dynasty. Shaped Stefan Dušan crowned Emperor; promulgates Dušan's Code and Battle of Kosovo – Prince Lazar and Sultan Murad I both killed.
